verdict.rationale: Obsidian's own docs say Obsidian Sync lets you collaborate on a shared vault with your team, and Sync offers version history to view or restore earlier note versions. Nothing in the evidence shows concurrent co-editing or how conflicting edits are merged, so the 'without stepping on each other's changes' half of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: documented conflict resolution or merge behavior for simultaneous edits, real-time co-editing, collaborator permission controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration of shared-vault collaboration.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can share a vault or space with collaborators and edit notes together without stepping on each other's changes

citations.quote: With Obsidian Sync you can collaborate on a shared vault with your team.
Version history - View or restore previous versions of a note.
